headline: Deep architectures tailored to Hi-C matrices for subcompartments, TAD boundaries and contact enhancement
label: Hi C Matrix Deep Learning
summary: Three Hi-C methods adapt model design to contact-matrix structure: single-cell subcompartment calling, compact TAD boundary prediction, and foundation-model-guided enhancement.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the treatment of Hi-C contact matrices as two-dimensional inputs for task-specific deep architectures. scSTEC annotates subcompartments from individual single-cell Hi-C matrices via direct two-dimensional embedding and chromosome-wise consensus, without imputation or cross-cell information. AxialTAD predicts TAD boundaries with an Axial Contrast Module and reports 76-80% fewer parameters than deepTAD. HiCP2GAN uses a pretrained Vision Transformer Hi-C foundation model as the discriminator in a plug-and-play GAN to enhance low-resolution contact maps. What is new is matrix-native design: per-cell analysis without imputation, parameter compactness, and transfer of foundation-model representations into generative enhancement. These are separate tasks rather than a shared model; the common element is the input representation and the architectural adaptation to it.
